VWAP moved -0.3 over the last 3 candles, the same way as the crossover; no other crossover in the 30 minutes before.
Bought the at-the-money put (2026-12-01 expiry) at the ask 168.65; bid 168.35. NIFTY 25,824.6, India VIX 17.20.

Backtest of these exact rules on real 1-minute option prices, Oct 2024 - Oct 2026 (VERIFIED_HISTORICAL): 861 trades, 30.9% won, average Rs -38 a trade after Rs 61 of charges; before charges it made Rs +20,199. It has not made money after costs: this paper book is the test.
thesis.strategy: EMA9 / VWAP crossover (the CEO's rules, cleaner signals)
why: A put gains if NIFTY keeps moving down after the crossover; the exits cut it the moment the 3-minute trend breaks.
numbers: none: held while candles close on the right side of EMA9
3-min close beyond EMA9, opposite cross, -25% or 15:20
thesis.risk: Most crossovers fail: in the backtest about 7 in 10 lost, a few big moves paid for them. Charges are about Rs 60 a round trip.
thesis.viability: Paper only, run beside the straddle for comparison.

reason: EMA9 crossed below VWAP on the 13:33 3-minute candle (VWAP sloping the same way); bought the 25,800 PE at 168.65. Exit on a 3-minute close beyond EMA9, an opposite cross, -25%, or 15:20.
